claim.scope_statement: For A/Q Q-isomorphic to a product of g elliptic curves, #A(Q)_tors≤16^g, sharp for every g≥2. Mazur’s published elliptic torsion classification is the imported input; an explicit curve and exact rational group-law certificate realize 16^g. No bound for arbitrary isogenous quotients or simple abelian varieties is claimed.
